notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes #1.3
notes.notes:
Fixed visual bug where water sometimes disappears
Fixed parkour room gate not resetting
Added death counter
Adjusted Microphone sensitivity
Added tutorials and option to mute tutorials

notes.title: Patch Notes #1.2
notes.notes:
Dying from TNT while blowing up barricades messes up save
Title screen doesn’t loop
Lever C gate open at start

notes.title: Micro Patch #1.11
notes.notes: Fixed disturbed widget stuck in nightmare mode

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes #1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed Blinding lights
 Added loading tips and tutorials
 Added game difficulties
 Improvements to monster AI
 First cutscene able to be skipped
 Option to mute microphone
 Fixed lock picking sound sometimes persisting after lock is picked
 Added autosave feature to specific modes
 Altered end logic

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes #1.02
notes.notes:
Fixed Blinding light near lever B
Fixed duplicate skeletons
Fixed spider getting stuck in two more areas
Fixed cabinet doors
Added confirmation UI to quit game and return to menu
Fixed flashlights falling out of the map when dropped from inventory
Fixed bloody jaws not spawning when dropped from inventory
Fixed rare chance for no burrows to spawn

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed “Find a way inside mine” not showing on start
Fixed interact sometimes staying on at car door
Fixed interacting through gates
Fixed various crouching issues
Absolutely slaughtered the game tick time (fps go brrr)
Fixed monster being yeeted out of the map sometimes when touching chains
Fixed objects staying in hand when soul bonding
Fixed cabinet doors bouncing back open after shutting
Fixed ability to fire flare gun during its cutscene
Fixed settings not saving over to new game
Greatly lowered chance of hunt during parkour (lever C)
End chase appears to be working now
Chains slightly more likely to trigger hunt
Attempted fix for objects falling through the floor
